Atlas can take care of everything from organizing my schedule to creating more fun life optimizing dashboards. But it can also go a step further and actually take real actions like making bookings. Sirrah crushes it in every way possible. When we were first looking into the restaurant I was super excited to eat at a place with such incredible decor. Then, of course, when I got there it was 10x cooler than the pictures could do justice. One thing I haven't seen a lot of people talk about is their outdoor seating. Sitting outdoors at a white table cloth in Meatpacking is a treat in and of itself. When you compare it to the interior of Sirrah you're left with a very tough choice of where to sit.

The hangar steak was delicious but I actually opted for the burger as I've fallen into the best burger hype that's going on right now. I haven't had all of the top ten yet but I will say as of right now Sirrah tops my list (incomplete right now). When you add in the unlimited fries which truly are top tier it's hard to beat. And that's just one course! Go check Sirrah out I promise this will be a special special experience. Let us know what you think!

response.caption:
Madeira can feel completely different depending on how you plan your days.

Most first-time visitors follow more or less the same formula: a few famous viewpoints, the classic levadas, waterfalls, Pico do Arieiro, Fanal — the places that appear again and again on Instagram, TikTok and every “best places in Madeira” list.

And when everyone follows the same routes and arrives at the same places at the same time, even the most beautiful spots can feel crowded.

But you don’t have to skip the famous places to experience a quieter side of Madeira.

Often, it’s simply about going at the right time.

And then there’s everything beyond the usual list.

Smaller viewpoints. Quieter hiking trails. Hidden waterfalls. Local spots. Short detours that most people simply drive past.

The challenge isn’t finding beautiful places in Madeira. There are hundreds of them.

The challenge is knowing where to go, when to go, and how to connect them into a route that actually makes sense.

🗺️ After 4 years of exploring Madeira, I put the places I personally recommend into my INTERACTIVE MADEIRA GUIDE & MAP — from iconic highlights to dozens of hikes, hidden spots, viewpoints, restaurants and lesser-known places across the island.

💡 Instead of spending hours saving random locations and then trying to figure out how they fit together, you can use my map and ready-to-follow itineraries to plan a trip that feels much more like your Madeira.

Everything is available through a convenient, offline-friendly mobile app that you can share with your travel buddy.

There’s also an itinerary builder, so you can combine my recommendations with your own saved places and create routes around your plans.

Add whatever you want to see, arrange your days the way you like, and have everything ready before you arrive.

Because good planning doesn’t mean seeing more places just for the sake of it.

It means spending your time on Madeira the way you actually want — hiking, exploring and enjoying the island instead of constantly figuring out where to go next.

I mean these guys are no joke. After learning about their background it makes a ton of sense that they're in the top 10 of @martiniswithfries list. John has been awarded two Michelin stars for his previous restaurants, Dovetail and Nix, one of which got starred in its first year. Amazing. John not only feeds the who's who in New York international business in the Wall Street hotel but his team also feeds a few different Edition hotels and has various other high class restaurants in Boston, Florida and the North Fork currently. This, on top of his long tenure in New York fine dining proves this guy's a total juggernaut and comes at no surprise that he's still crushing. 

Juan Santa Cruz reminds me of the guy in the Dos Equis commercial in both look, experience and charisma. He opened the first Casa Cruz in Buenos Aires before moving to London and opening multiple restaurants over there. What I really appreciate about Juan is how he thinks about his establishments. He's quoted saying he wants people to leave simply saying "That was fun." Short and sweet and genuinely one of the best feelings you can have when leaving a place. He also approached investors about @casacruznyc with a simple requirement of being nice and interesting, foregoing status. Safe to say @obvio.nyc was destined to make waves.

It's funny to think how much St. Marks has changed in the last twenty years. Ten Degrees was there to see it all. In a lot of ways, you could argue they inspired the wave of all the boujiee places you see all along the multifaceted street that you see today. Would be curious if anyone knows what was in the space prior to Ten Degrees. In any case, twenty years in New York let alone lower Manhattan is no accident. Moti created a space with staying power, and there are a lot of reasons for that.

In addition to all the great deals like BOGO drinks during happy hour they have a lot of other  creative and interesting offerings that make the place special. media.transcript: Did you guys know this 20 year old wine bar in the East Village is doing buy one get one free drinks and make your own charcuterie boards? And they're serving one of New York's best sandwiches, the Bafana. 10 Degrees was founded by Mahdi Hassan in 2006. Hassan founded the bar to be a rejection of what people normally associate with St. Mark's. The goal of the place was to provide high quality food and high quality wine for the East villains who want a taste of the finer things every now and again. A big highlight of the bar is their collaboration with Mr. Bafana who also has a stall in Time Out Market. If you're not familiar with a Bafana, it's a Portuguese sandwich made with pork that's marinated for a long time in garlic, spices, and white wine and then served on a Portuguese roll. These sandwiches pair super well when you're getting buy one get one free drinks during happy hour which runs every single day. It's a really excellent date spot and also fun for going out in the back room.
